hero.title: At KIB for Business Services, we don't work within market boundaries… we draw them.
paragraphs: We don't move with the flow of business… we set the rhythm that companies move to.
We are the entity that doesn't offer a service, but builds a system, creates influence, and establishes a presence that precedes the client's name before they arrive.
We don't run with an office mentality…

But with a mentality of an institution that decisions are built around, standards are measured by, and that is referred to in the details that make the difference between a company that operates… and a company that is respected.
Partner in decision… partner in expansion… and partner in influence.
Here… a new phase of engagement begins.
A phase that doesn't depend on what we do for you… but on what we build with you.

about.title: Who we are and what
about.paragraph1: KIB Finance is not just another brokerage firm; it is a specialised financial institution built on clear governance, strong risk discipline and deep knowledge of the regional financing landscape.
about.paragraph2: We believe that financing is not a quick product to be sold, but a strategic responsibility that shapes the future of companies and projects.
about.bullet1: A strong professional presence that reflects the strength of the company and market trust
about.bullet2: High analytical capability – reading numbers, risks and cash flows with precision
about.bullet3: Operational confidentiality – full protection for every file and piece of information
about.bullet4: A long‑term vision – we look at the client as a partner, not a single transaction
about.introParagraph1: We believe that financing is not merely a service to be delivered, but a responsibility to be managed, a partnership to be built, and a strategic decision that shapes the future of companies and projects.
about.introParagraph2: The Board of Directors has adopted a comprehensive conceptual framework that defines our institutional identity, anchors our values, strengthens governance mechanisms and lays the foundations on which every relationship, service and decision is built.

services.title: Specialised
services.subtitle: We design integrated financing structures for institutions, projects and investors.
services.modalConsultCta: Get a consultation for this service

corporateFinance.title: Corporate finance
corporateFinance.desc: Integrated financing solutions for large companies and institutions delivered with high professional standards.
corporateFinance.fullDesc: We provide institutional financing solutions tailored for companies and large organisations seeking to achieve their expansion and operational objectives. We act as a strategic partner that understands each organisation's requirements and designs the optimal financing structure, securing the best terms and pricing through our broad network of financing partners.

features.5: Negotiation with banks and financing institutions

projectFinance.title: Project finance
projectFinance.desc: Supporting investment projects from planning to full execution.
projectFinance.fullDesc: We accompany investment projects at every stage, from feasibility studies and financing structures through to deal closing and project launch. Our extensive experience in project finance enables us to deliver innovative solutions that fit each project's nature, size and sector.

features.3: Real estate and infrastructure project financing

riskManagement.title: Risk management
riskManagement.desc: Comprehensive assessment of financial risks and design of appropriate protection strategies.
riskManagement.fullDesc: We recognise that risk management is a core pillar of every successful financing decision. Our specialised team performs a thorough analysis of financial and operational risks and develops clear strategies to mitigate them, protect client assets and ensure business continuity.

internationalFinance.title: International finance
internationalFinance.desc: Opening external financing channels to support clients' projects globally.
internationalFinance.fullDesc: We maintain a wide international network of financial institutions and regional and global banks, enabling us to open external financing channels for our clients. We help companies access international capital markets and secure funding on competitive terms.

features.1: Financing from regional and international banks
features.4: Letters of credit and international guarantees

financialAdvisory.title: Financial advisory
financialAdvisory.desc: Specialised financial advisory based on rigorous data and number analysis.
financialAdvisory.fullDesc: Our financial advisory service provides deep and objective analysis of a company's financial position and sets a clear roadmap to achieve its financial goals. Every recommendation we make is grounded in real data and numbers, far from guesswork or untested assumptions.

features.1: Comprehensive financial analysis of the company

debtRestructuring.title: Debt restructuring
debtRestructuring.desc: Reorganising financial obligations to improve cash flow and reduce burdens.
debtRestructuring.fullDesc: We support companies facing pressure from their financial obligations by restructuring their debts in ways that improve cash flow and reduce financial strain. We negotiate with creditors on behalf of the client to reach sustainable solutions that safeguard business continuity.

features.1: Analysis of the current debt structure
